transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi, yes, I do have a few questions. First, I'm wondering when I can start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to avoid heavy work for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thank you for letting me know. I also wanted to ask when I can start using my eye gel for dry eyes again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's good to know, thank you. Another thing, I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Some mild light sensitivity can be normal as your eye adjusts, and wearing sunglasses outside can help if things just seem brighter than usual.

But if it’s significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, especially if the eye is red and painful, that is not normal and may need checking.

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Some mild light sensitivity can be normal as your eye adjusts, and wearing sunglasses outside can help if things just seem brighter than usual.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I'm sorry to interrupt, but should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for the vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation, and it should improve quickly over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, it should be checked.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all I needed to know. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Are all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they are. Thanks again for your assistance!
